mechanism: Rasagiline is an irreversible MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate mefloquine's CNS effects and increase risk of serotonin syndrome; mefloquine also has cardiac arrhythmia potential and CNS toxicity that may be amplified.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if malaria prophylaxis is essential, consider alternative antimalarials (atovaquone-proguanil or doxycycline); ensure adequate washout period if switching between agents.
